name: ShengShou Lustrous Cube 3x3 (Magnetic)
description: ShengShou Lustrous Cube 3x3 is a great little puzzle with an extra trick. Not only can you solve this puzzle, but it also glows! You can see all of the colors with the internal light on in complete darkness! It has a rechargeable battery inside and comes with a charger. This version has piece-to-piece magnets with a medium magnetic feel.
